# koloskopi

Colonoscopy is the surveillance procedure required for PSC patients within 18 months to screen for colorectal cancer, with a national target of 80% compliance.

## Claims

- På landsplan har 277 ud af 325 patienter med PSC fået foretaget koloskopi inden for 18 måneder, svarende til 85 % ([[danibd|DANIBD]], [[primaer-skleroserende-kolangitis|primær skleroserende kolangitis]], [[koloskopi]])
- I udredningen er der stærk anbefaling for, og deraf bred international enighed om, at diagnoserne stilles ved koloskopi ([[koloskopi]])
- 79 % af de i alt 2385 nydiagnosticerede voksne har fået foretaget koloskopi ([[danibd|DANIBD]], [[koloskopi]])
- Udviklingsmålet for koloskopi-udredning af voksne IBD-patienter er nået på landsplan ([[danibd|DANIBD]], [[koloskopi]])
- Alle regioner lever op til eller er tæt på at opnå udviklingsmålet for koloskopi, med regional variation fra 76 % til 86 % i Region Sjælland ([[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]], [[koloskopi]])
- Fire afdelinger (Hvidovre, OUH Svendborg, Aarhus og Gødstrup) har under 70 % af nydiagnosticerede voksne udredt med koloskopi ([[hvidovre|Hvidovre]], [[ouh-svendborg|OUH Svendborg]], [[aarhus-university-hospital|Aarhus University Hospital]], [[goedstrup-hospital|Gødstrup Hospital]], [[koloskopi]])
- Udviklingsmålet for indikator 1b er, at mindst 80 % af nydiagnosticerede børn og unge skal have foretaget alle tre undersøgelser (gastroskopi, koloskopi og MR-scanning/kapselendoskopi) i udredningsforløbet ([[gastroskopi|Gastroskopi]], [[koloskopi]], [[mr-scanning-af-tyndtarm|MR-scanning af tyndtarm]], [[kapselendoskopi|Kapselendoskopi]])
- Flere patienter er primært henvist til og udredt i kirurgisk regi med sigmoideoskopi/koloskopi alene ([[sigmoideoskopi|Sigmoideoskopi]], [[koloskopi]])
- Der er stærk anbefaling for, og deraf international enighed om, at det postoperative forløb bedst monitoreres med endoskopisk opfølgning ([[crohns-disease|Crohn's Disease]], [[koloskopi]])
- Surveillance colonoscopies result in early diagnosis of colorectal cancer and improved survival ([[koloskopi]], [[colorectal-cancer|Colorectal Cancer]])
- There is strong evidence and broad international agreement for offering all PSC patients annual systematic follow-up with colonoscopy ([[primary-sclerosing-cholangitis|Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis]], [[koloskopi]])
- The development target for PSC colonoscopy surveillance is that 80% of patients receive colonoscopy within 18 months ([[primary-sclerosing-cholangitis|Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis]], [[koloskopi]])
- Nationally, 81% of PSC patients received colonoscopy within 18 months during the period 01.10.2023 - 30.09.2024, meeting the development target of at least 80% ([[primary-sclerosing-cholangitis|Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis]], [[koloskopi]])
- All five regions achieved results meeting the development target of at least 80% for PSC colonoscopy surveillance ([[primary-sclerosing-cholangitis|Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis]], [[koloskopi]])
- Regional variation in PSC colonoscopy completion rates ranges from 79% to 85% ([[primary-sclerosing-cholangitis|Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis]], [[koloskopi]])
- Among the eight departments with more than 10 PSC patients, department variation in colonoscopy completion rates ranges from 76% to 95% ([[primary-sclerosing-cholangitis|Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis]], [[koloskopi]])
- In 65% of performed colonoscopies for PSC surveillance, biopsies were taken ([[koloskopi]], [[primary-sclerosing-cholangitis|Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis]])
- All PSC surveillance colonoscopies were performed in hospital settings ([[koloskopi]], [[primary-sclerosing-cholangitis|Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis]])
- The development target for PSC colonoscopy surveillance is assessed as still relevant ([[primary-sclerosing-cholangitis|Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis]], [[koloskopi]])
